steps: Rinse the toor dal and pressure cook it with water and the turmeric until soft.
Heat the oil, let half the cumin sizzle, then fry the onion, ginger, half the garlic and the green chilli.
Add the tomato, most of the chilli powder, the coriander powder and salt and cook until soft.
Whisk the cooked dal lightly and stir it into the pan.
Simmer for 5 to 7 minutes, adding hot water if it is too thick.
Stir in the garam masala, crushed kasuri methi and coriander leaves.
For the tadka, heat the ghee and fry the rest of the cumin, the rest of the garlic and the bay leaf until the garlic is light gold.
Take it off the heat, add the asafoetida and the last pinch of chilli powder, and pour it over the dal.
note: The tadka is now in ghee, as all three sources do. Cream is gone because none of the sources use it.
